narrative.overview:
The Cold-Blue Portal is a dense, dark-locked film interface built for finding, selecting, and watching rather than promotion. Near-black canvas, cold slate panels, portrait posters, compact facts, and one sky/cyan interaction signal make the public product feel like a working source portal.

Discovery tasks are explicit siblings. Search owns viewer-local history and source choice; the source-update grid owns its own paging; Douban owns its own filters and paging. Title facts, ranged episode browsing, and complete in-player episode navigation each receive a distinct task region. Administration stays in the shared Yueli console family and inherits its semantic light/dark shell instead of the public dark lock.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-locked public browse, search, title, history, and playback surfaces.
White YTV wordmark with one small sky/cyan dot.
Search history capped at eight and viewer source exclusions stored locally.
Independent source-update and Douban poster modules with separate batch actions.
Compact real-poster Continue Watching and a de-duplicated two-to-six-column playback-history grid.
Real source posters in a two-to-six-column 2:3 grid and compact horizontal search results.
Stable 50-episode ranges on title and watch routes.
App-owned central play/replay plus a 20–22rem single-line desktop playlist.
Shared semantic admin console with dashboard, sources, search insights, and public profile settings only.

rules.name: The One Sky Signal Rule
rules.body: Sky/cyan is the sole public interaction color; it marks action and state without becoming a large surface.

rules.name: The White Mark Rule
rules.body: The YTV name stays white and gains identity from one 6px sky dot; never apply a gradient or multicolor fill to the public wordmark.

rules.name: The Split Appearance Rule
rules.body: Public routes stay dark-locked, while the shared administration shell retains its semantic light/dark appearance control.

rules.name: The Workhorse Only Rule
rules.body: Use the same sans family throughout YTV; let compact facts, poster density, charts, and row structure provide character.

rules.name: The Independent Modules Rule
rules.body: Search, source updates, and Douban never share paging, filtering, batch actions, or recovery state.

rules.name: The Density Ladder Rule
rules.body: Preserve the 2→3→4→5→6 source-poster progression and 1→2→4 search-result progression.

rules.name: The Complete Player Rule
rules.body: The watch route contains every episode in stable 50-episode ranges; desktop reserves 20–22rem for the list and mobile uses document scroll.

rules.name: The Media-Only Lift Rule
rules.body: Public shadows lift the title poster and video stage; ordinary public components use tone and border, while admin uses shared semantic depth.

rules.name: The Source Poster Rule
rules.body: Homepage poster cards always represent real administrator-selected source entries with a 2:3 image well and compact facts.

rules.name: The Playlist Row Rule
rules.body: Watch episodes form one continuous divided list; the current row gains a sky leading edge and tint without changing geometry.

dos: Do keep public routes dark-locked and administration on the shared semantic light/dark console.
Do keep search history unique, local, clearable, and capped at eight.
Do persist disabled viewer source keys, preserve at least one selected source, and respect globally enabled definitions.
Do give source updates and Douban independent headers, actions, filters, paging, and recovery.
Do use stable 50-episode ranges on title and watch routes.
Do keep the app-owned play/replay control unmistakable in ready, paused, and ended states.
Do use one-line 44px playlist rows and keep every episode reachable on the watch route.
Do restrict source creation to deployment-approved definitions while allowing install/remove, display-name and policy management.
Do auto-save source changes with explicit row feedback and keep one-click probing available for all installed sources.
Do keep the initial policy explicit: zy360/mdzy/zuid enabled, qgikun disabled, and only zy360 home-visible.
Do keep yinghua, qgsuoni, and qgyouzhiziyuanku as approved but initially uninstalled and disabled candidates.
donts: Don't place Douban filters, hot entries, or batch action inside the search panel.
Don't let one batch action change both source updates and external discovery.
Don't render watch episodes as a multi-column button grid or send viewers away to find the full list.
Don't merge title facts, episode browsing, and playback into one oversized card.
Don't add a placeholder access-control page or unsupported user/role workflows to the admin console.
Don't add deployment endpoints, adapters, or secrets to source settings.
Don't require a redundant per-row Save button for independently editable source fields.
